A '''Retashen Dazer''' is an alcoholic beverage that is a mixture of mead and ewe's milk. It comes from [[Retash]], a cluster of islands leagues offshore of the [[Westlands|Mainland]], although the exact location of these islands has not been ascertained. It is likely these islands are small with little produce for trade, for even the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' do not often visit them. Despite that, the drink became somewhat infamous. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Retash}}

When the [[Asha'man]] work in the [[Black Tower]], [[Nalaam]] asks [[Androl]] to explain to them what is a ''Retashen Dazer''. Androl tells them and says  it is ''"Foul stuff.". ''Androl claims that he has visited once and drank it on a bet.'' ''{{Ref/book|13|46}}
